aim: To determine whether the primers can amplify/temperature titration worksheet

conclusions.head: 1. Amplification confirmed.
conclusions.body: All 9 template wells yielded a single, specific band across two independent gDNAs (NA11518, NA06075), demonstrating reproducible amplification on diverse genomic backgrounds.

conclusions.head: 2. All three NTC wells are clean across all Ta points.
conclusions.body: This is the gel's most critical signal — arguably more important than the target bands themselves. It rules out detectable primer dimers and contamination, which is essential for clearing the redesigned R4 primer for multiplex use.

conclusions.head: 3. Working Ta ≥ 55–65°C, optimum at 55–60°C.
conclusions.body: Comparing signal intensity across the three temperatures, band intensity shows a slight increasing trend, with the 55°C lane being the brightest.
